Farm_bot.changelog:
Changes in Farm_bot:
- Improved performance on some processors 
- Added a Log button (saves the entire console to a file) 
- Minor fixes and feature improvements. 
- Returned the ability to send notifications to private messages

Universal.changelog:
Changes in Universal:
- Added the 'Only hell event' parameter 
- If this option is enabled, the account will only participate in hellish events, then close the game until the next event.

Hunt.changelog:
Changes in Hunt:
- Added error checking for the tether and emulator.
- Reduced the waiting time before leaving the guild (-10 minutes).
- Added gift collection before going hunting.
- Added additional spots for TP (small k).
- Increased coin collection time from 3 → 5 minutes. 
-Changed the default value for the number of monsters from 40 → 100. 
- Changed the default value for the type of hunt to ‘mix’.
-Minor fixes and corrections.

Rally_party.changelog:
Changes in Rally_party:
- Now you can load the 'auto' list and add your quests there, for example (154, 202) 
- quests from the 'auto' list will be completed automatically, while yours will require manual completion.
- Some fixes
